Tribal Aggression#000.src: Have you gotten our totem back yet? The Eagle camp is across the river, on the other side of the canyon.
Tribal Aggression#000.dst: ¿Ya has recuperado nuestro tótem? El campamento Águila está al otro lado del río, pasado el cañón.

Tribal Aggression#002.src: My tribes worries our own business, stranger.
Tribal Aggression#002.dst: Mi tribu se ocupa de sus asuntos, forastero.
Tribal Aggression#002.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#003.src: Oh, my apologies, I did not realize you are a warrior of the province! We would be grateful of your help.
Tribal Aggression#003.dst: Oh, disculpa, ¡no sabía que eras un guerrero de la Provincia! Te agradeceríamos tu ayuda.
Tribal Aggression#003.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#004.src: Our sacred owl totem that we worship was stolen by the cunning Eagle Tribe many years ago. Its magical properties used to bring prosperity to our camp.
Tribal Aggression#004.dst: La astuta tribu Águila robó hace muchos años el sagrado tótem del búho que adoramos. Su magia traía prosperidad a nuestro campamento.
Tribal Aggression#004.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#005.src: However, the Eagle tribe are not victorious, we possess their mystic eagle totem, but alas, I do not know who was the original thief.
Tribal Aggression#005.dst: Pero la tribu Águila tampoco ha ganado: tenemos su místico tótem del águila, aunque, por desgracia, no sé quién fue el primer ladrón.
Tribal Aggression#005.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#006.src: We have been at war for years now, despite being neighbors. Without our totem, our rivalry will continue for ages and peace will never again be felt in our hearts.
Tribal Aggression#006.dst: Llevamos años en guerra, aunque seamos vecinos. Sin nuestro tótem, esta rivalidad durará siglos y la paz nunca volverá a nuestros corazones.
Tribal Aggression#006.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#007.src: Retrieve our totem, and the blessing of the Owl spirit will be with you.
Tribal Aggression#007.dst: Recupera nuestro tótem y la bendición del espíritu del Búho te acompañará.
Tribal Aggression#007.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#008.src: Now, enter the Eagle Camp across the river, you may have to search the camp, I'm sure they have hidden our totem!
Tribal Aggression#008.dst: Ve al campamento Águila, cruzando el río, y regístralo; ¡seguro que han escondido nuestro tótem!
Tribal Aggression#008.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#009.src: Enter the Eagle Camp and talk to Favian
Tribal Aggression#009.dst: Entra en el campamento Águila y habla con Favian

Tribal Aggression#010.src: Greetings, what brings you to the noble Eagle tribe?
Tribal Aggression#010.dst: Saludos, ¿qué te trae a la noble tribu Águila?
Tribal Aggression#010.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#011.src: You seek the Owl totem? The cursed Owl tribe trying to retain their lost dignity again.
Tribal Aggression#011.dst: ¿Buscas el tótem del búho? La maldita tribu Búho intentando otra vez recuperar su dignidad perdida.
Tribal Aggression#011.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#012.src: Why should we give you their totem back? They stole our source of enlightenment all those years ago.
Tribal Aggression#012.dst: ¿Por qué íbamos a devolverte su tótem? Hace años nos robaron a nosotros nuestra fuente de iluminación.
Tribal Aggression#012.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#013.src: Tell you what, if you can retrieve our Eagle Totem, I will allow you to go return the Owl totem.
Tribal Aggression#013.dst: Te propongo algo: si recuperas nuestro tótem del águila, te dejaré llevar el tótem del búho de vuelta.
Tribal Aggression#013.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#014.src: I'm sure they hid the totem, but if you are able to find, I await your return!
Tribal Aggression#014.dst: Seguro que escondieron el tótem, pero si lo encuentras, ¡espero tu regreso!
Tribal Aggression#014.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#015.src: Bring back the Eagle Totem from the Owl Camp
Tribal Aggression#015.dst: Trae el tótem del águila desde el campamento Búho

Tribal Aggression#016.src: Wonderful! You may now enter the cave to retrieve the blasted Owl totem.
Tribal Aggression#016.dst: ¡Magnífico! Ya puedes entrar en la cueva a por el dichoso tótem del búho.
Tribal Aggression#016.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#017.src: Be careful, there are Eagle guardians in the cave, be prepared traveller.
Tribal Aggression#017.dst: Cuidado, hay guardianes águila en la cueva. Ve preparado, viajero.
Tribal Aggression#017.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#018.src: Once you get the totem, you may return it to its original tribe.
Tribal Aggression#018.dst: Cuando tengas el tótem, podrás devolverlo a su tribu original.
Tribal Aggression#018.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#019.src: Hopefully, we two camps will never set foot on another's land in an attempt steal back the totems, and live in peace.
Tribal Aggression#019.dst: Ojalá nuestros campamentos nunca vuelvan a pisar la tierra del otro para robar los tótems, y vivamos en paz.
Tribal Aggression#019.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#020.src: Anyways, hurry up, even the thought of the two totems sharing the same space makes me sick.
Tribal Aggression#020.dst: En fin, date prisa; solo de pensar en los dos tótems en el mismo sitio me pongo enfermo.
Tribal Aggression#020.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#021.src: Retrieve the Owl Totem and return it to the Owl Camp
Tribal Aggression#021.dst: Recupera el tótem del búho y devuélvelo al campamento Búho

Tribal Aggression#022.src: I-Is that, the totem? My, it has been a long time since the owl has been with me. Though I wonder if the Eagle and the Owl totem possess the same mystic powers.
Tribal Aggression#022.dst: ¿E-es ese el tótem? Vaya, cuánto tiempo sin tener el búho conmigo. Aunque me pregunto si los tótems del Águila y del Búho tienen el mismo poder místico.
Tribal Aggression#022.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#023.src: To think, such a long war could end so quickly and by the help of a single person.
Tribal Aggression#023.dst: Quién lo diría: una guerra tan larga, terminada tan deprisa y con la ayuda de una sola persona.
Tribal Aggression#023.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#024.src: Many thanks to you! I shall keep my promise, please accept this reward, and may the Owl be forever with you.
Tribal Aggression#024.dst: ¡Muchísimas gracias! Cumpliré mi promesa; acepta esta recompensa, y que el Búho te acompañe siempre.
Tribal Aggression#024.speaker: Caras
